018/**
019 * Builds a CommandContainer that can be registered into CommandManager.
020 *
021 * @author Ghost_chu
022 */
023public class CommandContainer {
024
025  @NotNull
026  private CommandHandler<?> executor;
027
028  private boolean hidden; // Hide from help, tabcomplete
029  /*
030    E.g you can use the command when having quickshop.removeall.self or quickshop.removeall.others permission
031  */
032  private List<String> selectivePermissions;
033  private List<String> permissions; // E.g quickshop.unlimited
034  @NotNull
035  private String prefix; // E.g /quickshop <prefix>
036  @Nullable
037  private Function<@NotNull String, @Nullable Component> description; // Will show in the /quickshop help, provide an arg that pass a player locale code
038
039  private boolean disabled; //Set command is disabled or not.
040  @Nullable
041  private Supplier<Boolean> disabledSupplier; //Set command is disabled or not.
042  @Nullable
043  private Supplier<Component> disablePlaceholder; //Set the text shown if command disabled
044  @Nullable
045  private Function<@Nullable CommandSender, @NotNull Component> disableCallback; //Set the callback that should return a text to shown
046
047  private Class<?> executorType;
048
049  /**
050   * Gets the text should be shown while command was disabled.
051   *
052   * @param sender the sender
053   *
054   * @return the text
055   */
056  @NotNull
057  public final Component getDisableText(@NotNull final CommandSender sender) {
058
059    if(this.getDisableCallback() != null) {
060      return this.getDisableCallback().apply(sender);
061    } else if(this.getDisablePlaceholder() != null && !CommonUtil.isEmptyComponent(this.getDisablePlaceholder().get())) {
062      return this.getDisablePlaceholder().get();
063    } else {
064      return Component.empty().color(NamedTextColor.GRAY).append(QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getTextManager().of(sender, "command.feature-not-enabled").forLocale());
065    }
066  }
067
068  @ApiStatus.Internal
069  @NotNull
070  public Class<?> getExecutorType() {
071
072    if(executorType == null) {
073      bakeExecutorType();
074    }
075    return executorType;
076  }
077
078  @ApiStatus.Internal
079  public void bakeExecutorType() {
080
081    for(final Method declaredMethod : getExecutor().getClass().getMethods()) {
082      if("onCommand".equals(declaredMethod.getName()) || "onTabComplete".equals(declaredMethod.getName())) {
083        if(declaredMethod.getParameterCount() != 3 || declaredMethod.isSynthetic() || declaredMethod.isBridge()) {
084          continue;
085        }
086        executorType = declaredMethod.getParameterTypes()[0];
087        return;
088      }
089    }
090    executorType = Object.class;
091  }
092
093  CommandContainer(@NotNull final CommandHandler<?> executor, final boolean hidden, final List<String> selectivePermissions, final List<String> permissions, @NotNull final String prefix, @Nullable final Function<@NotNull String, @Nullable Component> description, final boolean disabled, @Nullable final Supplier<Boolean> disabledSupplier, @Nullable final Supplier<Component> disablePlaceholder, @Nullable final Function<@Nullable CommandSender, @NotNull Component> disableCallback, final Class<?> executorType) {
094
095    if(executor == null) {
096      throw new NullPointerException("executor is marked non-null but is null");
097  }
098    if(prefix == null) {
099      throw new NullPointerException("prefix is marked non-null but is null");
100    }
101    this.executor = executor;
102    this.hidden = hidden;
103    this.selectivePermissions = selectivePermissions;
104    this.permissions = permissions;
105    this.prefix = prefix;
106    this.description = description;
107    this.disabled = disabled;
108    this.disabledSupplier = disabledSupplier;
109    this.disablePlaceholder = disablePlaceholder;
110    this.disableCallback = disableCallback;
111    this.executorType = executorType;
112  }
113
114  public static class CommandContainerBuilder {
115
116    private CommandHandler<?> executor;
117    private boolean hidden;
118    private java.util.ArrayList<String> selectivePermissions;
119    private java.util.ArrayList<String> permissions;
120    private String prefix;
121    private Function<@NotNull String, @Nullable Component> description;
122    private boolean disabled;
123    private Supplier<Boolean> disabledSupplier;
124    private Supplier<Component> disablePlaceholder;
125    private Function<@Nullable CommandSender, @NotNull Component> disableCallback;
126    private Class<?> executorType;
127
128    CommandContainerBuilder() {
129
130    }
131
132    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder executor(@NotNull final CommandHandler<?> executor) {
133
134      if(executor == null) {
135        throw new NullPointerException("executor is marked non-null but is null");
136      }
137      this.executor = executor;
138      return this;
139    }
140
141    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder hidden(final boolean hidden) {
142
143      this.hidden = hidden;
144      return this;
145    }
146
147    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder selectivePermission(final String selectivePermission) {
148
149      if(this.selectivePermissions == null) {
150        this.selectivePermissions = new java.util.ArrayList<String>();
151      }
152      this.selectivePermissions.add(selectivePermission);
153      return this;
154    }
155
156    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder selectivePermissions(final java.util.Collection<? extends String> selectivePermissions) {
157
158      if(selectivePermissions == null) {
159        throw new NullPointerException("selectivePermissions cannot be null");
160      }
161      if(this.selectivePermissions == null) {
162        this.selectivePermissions = new java.util.ArrayList<String>();
163      }
164      this.selectivePermissions.addAll(selectivePermissions);
165      return this;
166    }
167
168    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder clearSelectivePermissions() {
169
170      if(this.selectivePermissions != null) this.selectivePermissions.clear();
171      return this;
172    }
173
174    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder permission(final String permission) {
175
176      if(this.permissions == null) this.permissions = new java.util.ArrayList<String>();
177      this.permissions.add(permission);
178      return this;
179    }
180
181    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder permissions(final java.util.Collection<? extends String> permissions) {
182
183      if(permissions == null) {
184        throw new NullPointerException("permissions cannot be null");
185      }
186      if(this.permissions == null) this.permissions = new java.util.ArrayList<String>();
187      this.permissions.addAll(permissions);
188      return this;
189    }
190
191    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder clearPermissions() {
192
193      if(this.permissions != null) this.permissions.clear();
194      return this;
195    }
196
197    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder prefix(@NotNull final String prefix) {
198
199      if(prefix == null) {
200        throw new NullPointerException("prefix is marked non-null but is null");
201      }
202      this.prefix = prefix;
203      return this;
204    }
205
206    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder description(@Nullable final Function<@NotNull String, @Nullable Component> description) {
207
208      this.description = description;
209      return this;
210    }
211
212    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder disabled(final boolean disabled) {
213
214      this.disabled = disabled;
215      return this;
216    }
217
218    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder disabledSupplier(@Nullable final Supplier<Boolean> disabledSupplier) {
219
220      this.disabledSupplier = disabledSupplier;
221      return this;
222    }
223
224    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder disablePlaceholder(@Nullable final Supplier<Component> disablePlaceholder) {
225
226      this.disablePlaceholder = disablePlaceholder;
227      return this;
228    }
229
230    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder disableCallback(@Nullable final Function<@Nullable CommandSender, @NotNull Component> disableCallback) {
231
232      this.disableCallback = disableCallback;
233      return this;
234    }
235
236    public CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder executorType(final Class<?> executorType) {
237
238      this.executorType = executorType;
239      return this;
240    }
241
242    public CommandContainer build() {
243
244      java.util.List<String> selectivePermissions;
245      switch(this.selectivePermissions == null? 0 : this.selectivePermissions.size()) {
246        case 0:
247          selectivePermissions = java.util.Collections.emptyList();
248          break;
249        case 1:
250          selectivePermissions = java.util.Collections.singletonList(this.selectivePermissions.get(0));
251          break;
252        default:
253          selectivePermissions = java.util.Collections.unmodifiableList(new java.util.ArrayList<String>(this.selectivePermissions));
254      }
255      java.util.List<String> permissions;
256      switch(this.permissions == null? 0 : this.permissions.size()) {
257        case 0:
258          permissions = java.util.Collections.emptyList();
259          break;
260        case 1:
261          permissions = java.util.Collections.singletonList(this.permissions.get(0));
262          break;
263        default:
264          permissions = java.util.Collections.unmodifiableList(new java.util.ArrayList<String>(this.permissions));
265      }
266      return new CommandContainer(this.executor, this.hidden, selectivePermissions, permissions, this.prefix, this.description, this.disabled, this.disabledSupplier, this.disablePlaceholder, this.disableCallback, this.executorType);
267    }
268
269    @Override
270    public String toString() {
271
272      return "CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder(executor=" + this.executor + ", hidden=" + this.hidden + ", selectivePermissions=" + this.selectivePermissions + ", permissions=" + this.permissions + ", prefix=" + this.prefix + ", description=" + this.description + ", disabled=" + this.disabled + ", disabledSupplier=" + this.disabledSupplier + ", disablePlaceholder=" + this.disablePlaceholder + ", disableCallback=" + this.disableCallback + ", executorType=" + this.executorType + ")";
273    }
274  }
275
276  public static CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder builder() {
277
278    return new CommandContainer.CommandContainerBuilder();
279  }

398  @Override
399  public boolean equals(final Object o) {
400
401    if(o == this) return true;
402    if(!(o instanceof CommandContainer)) return false;
403    final CommandContainer other = (CommandContainer)o;
404    return this.isHidden() == other.isHidden()
405           && this.isDisabled() == other.isDisabled()
406           && Objects.equals(this.getExecutor(), other.getExecutor())
407           && Objects.equals(this.getSelectivePermissions(), other.getSelectivePermissions())
408           && Objects.equals(this.getPermissions(), other.getPermissions())
409           && Objects.equals(this.getPrefix(), other.getPrefix())
410           && Objects.equals(this.getDescription(), other.getDescription())
411           && Objects.equals(this.getDisabledSupplier(), other.getDisabledSupplier())
412           && Objects.equals(this.getDisablePlaceholder(), other.getDisablePlaceholder())
413           && Objects.equals(this.getDisableCallback(), other.getDisableCallback())
414           && Objects.equals(this.getExecutorType(), other.getExecutorType());
415  }
416
417  @Override
418  public int hashCode() {

421  }

427  }
